patch: original receiver MLP output + strength * (full donor MOLT contribution - full receiver MOLT contribution)
gate_only: original receiver MLP output + strength * (donor gate - receiver gate) * receiver low-rank output
ablation: original receiver MLP output - strength * receiver MOLT contribution
heldout_policy: For every feature/site test strengths 1, 4.5 and the highest-P6 primary strength; retain all trials. No heldout strength optimization.
feature_selection: Labels and dashboard activation evidence, before observing model steering outcomes; lexical controls explicitly marked.
interpretation: Shared arthropod/animal labels are hypotheses, not dedicated spider or ant representations. All direct edits are confined to one layer and one position per trial.
